name: jsonA
meaning: Wraps array items in "[ " and " ]" after removing a trailing comma. Built for items made with jsonAv.
open_question: Old text-building JSON API from before native JSON functions.

name: jsonAv
meaning: Prepares a value as a JSON array element: reads the value as JSON through a BaseElements call; if it is an object or array it returns it, else it encodes the value; returns the text with a trailing comma, or "?" with the error in $json.error. BaseElements plugin function is <Function Missing> in the DDR; its name and behavior are not shown.
open_question: Depends on the BaseElements plugin (2 function calls missing from DDR). Check whether the target needs it.

name: jsonDelete

Returns the new JSON, or "?" with the JavaScript error name saved in $json.error. BaseElements plugin function is <Function Missing> in the DDR; its name and behavior are not shown.
open_question: Generated JavaScript run through a plugin; port with native JSON handling.

name: jsonFilter
meaning: Filters a JSON array of objects by a JavaScript snippet that starts with a property name (pass = item.<expression>), run through a BaseElements call. Empty expression returns empty. BaseElements plugin function is <Function Missing> in the DDR; its name and behavior are not shown.
open_question: Expression is JavaScript text supplied by callers; none found in this file.

name: jsonGet
meaning: Reads a value from JSON by key, array index or JSONPath using a BaseElements call. Normalizes the JSON first, treats numeric keys as array indexes, returns empty when the key does not exist (checked with jsonGetKeyList), "?" on error, and stores the error text in $json.error. BaseElements plugin function is <Function Missing> in the DDR; its name and behavior are not shown.
open_question: Used by 14 files in karbon_Generator; depends on the plugin. Return of "?" and $json.error are the old error convention.

name: jsonGetKeyList
meaning: Returns the keys of a JSON object (one level) as a return-separated list, using generated JavaScript run through a BaseElements call. Returns "?" on error. BaseElements plugin function is <Function Missing> in the DDR; its name and behavior are not shown.

name: jsonGetValueList
meaning: Returns the values of a JSON object or array (one level) as a return-separated list; nested objects are returned as JSON text. Uses generated JavaScript through a BaseElements call; "?" on error. BaseElements plugin function is <Function Missing> in the DDR; its name and behavior are not shown.
open_question: No caller found.

name: jsonMerge
meaning: Shallow merge of source into target using JavaScript Object.assign (with a polyfill) run through a BaseElements call. Returns the merged JSON or "?" on error. BaseElements plugin function is <Function Missing> in the DDR; its name and behavior are not shown.

name: jsonModify
meaning: Adds or changes a property or array item at a key, index or path (such as invoice.line[2]qty), creating missing levels. Quotes newValue unless it is JSON or a short number (under 17 digits), then runs generated JavaScript through a BaseElements call. Returns the changed JSON, or "?" with the error in $json.error. BaseElements plugin function is <Function Missing> in the DDR; its name and behavior are not shown.
target_signature: jsonSet(json: object|unknown[], path: string, value: unknown): object|unknown[]
open_question: Used by 7 files. Path syntax is the JavaScript-like form of this function, not JSONPath standard; check callers' paths.

name: jsonO
meaning: Wraps object members in "{ " and " }" after removing a trailing comma. Built for members made with jsonOp.

name: jsonOp
meaning: Formats one key/value pair as a JSON object member with a trailing comma. If the value is itself JSON it keeps it as-is, else it encodes the pair through a BaseElements call; "?" on error with the message in $json.error. BaseElements plugin function is <Function Missing> in the DDR; its name and behavior are not shown.
open_question: Numbers longer than 16 digits must be passed as text (header note).

name: jsonPrettyPrint
meaning: Pretty-prints a JSON string with the given whitespace (default two spaces), via JSON.stringify in a BaseElements call. Non-JSON text is returned unchanged. "?" on error. BaseElements plugin function is <Function Missing> in the DDR; its name and behavior are not shown.

name: jsonValidate
meaning: Validates a JSON string through a BaseElements call: returns 1 if valid, "?" if not, and sets $json.error. BaseElements plugin function is <Function Missing> in the DDR; its name and behavior are not shown.
open_question: Returns 1 or "?" rather than booleans.

name: quoter

open_question: Only relevant if the target keeps the code generator.

name: jsonModifyStep
